gaps.lighting: hero is finally sunlit: warm key at 8.9 deg, long soft palm/lamp shadows, sheen on the plaza (warm share of frame 0.013 to 0.048). But every fixed-camera view (street_sgt, shops, kings_park, bridge_skyline) has no cast shadows at all, because G.focus and the 120 m shadow radius follow the player at EQ, 500+ m away. St Georges Tce at 17:00 should be raked by sun along its axis. Instead it is one flat value (std of the lower frame 0.033). In hero the player stands in a trunk shadow strip (player luma 41 vs 93.5 in hero_back).
gaps.time_of_day: hero_night got worse vs r1: player luma 54.5 to 37.6 (floor 40) and luma p5 5.9 to 0.6. The right half of the plaza is pure black. The lamp pool is an additive cream wash that ignores albedo, so the pavers lose all texture inside it. Tower windows are still a per-cell salt-and-pepper checkerboard, not lit floors. Noon (hero_noon) is acceptable.
gaps.palette: Golden frames now sit near the bible (paletteDE hero 19.2, river_cbd 18.3). Remaining off-palette areas: the street views are a cool grey-blue with no warm light (street_sgt sat 0.256, shops 0.261); noon pavers read as a near-white checker (avoid list); the inlet water in hero is milky beige rather than #2A566E.
gaps.materials: Asphalt is a featureless grey sheet with no line marking anywhere (street_sgt, shops, aerial). Cause: the road-marks patch inserts its paint after '#include <map_fragment>', but the library 'pbr' patch's PBR_TINT sits after it and overwrites diffuseColor. Also: the EQ quay coping is a 6 cm flat strip (tricia1 shows a ~0.4 m rounded limestone seat-edge); bench legs are glaring white blocks; the Mends deck boards read ~0.5 m wide; palm trunks are visibly faceted at 3 m.
gaps.vegetation: Palms improved (3 variants, trimmed boot), but the backlit fronds read as saturated yellow ribbons (hero right edge, hero_back) instead of a grey-green Washingtonia mass. The kings_park frame was ruined by pale stake trunks above the crowns (fixed after the shots). The bush floor in the foreground is near-black lichen speckle (shrub albedo 0.045-0.08 x AO 0.6).
gaps.architecture: Third round below 5. The skyline is still a field of uniform cream grids, identical floor-to-floor from podium to roof (bridge_skyline, river_cbd, aerial): no mechanical floors, no vertical rhythm, no tone variation between towers, and FR.white 0.42 / lightAlu 0.50 frames read near-white in sun. eq2 and kpview show dark blue-glass masses with banded plant floors. The low-rise belt is untextured boxes, and street-level shopfronts are flat pastel panels (street_sgt right).
gaps.characters: Adult, readable, consistent (player and peds in hero_back, phone_hud). Remaining: the night player is below the luma floor (37.6) and reads as a dark cut-out. The dark hoodie silhouette gets no sun rim because the player stands in shadow in hero.
gaps.composition: Measured horizon: hero 0.39 and phone 0.38 (target 0.45). The QA harness forces camPitch 0.16 (shoot.mjs) while the game default is 0.10, so the r2 pitch fix never reached the shots. The hero frame is cut into vertical stripes (trunk | player | pole | trunk | trunk). alongShore restarts its spacing at every shoreline vertex: a palm stands 1.0 m from the hero spawn and the lamps are 9.4 m apart instead of 17.
gaps.atmosphere: Clouds are back and river_cbd is the best frame of the set. Distance is still milky: the Mends skyline at 1.3 km is low contrast (blue transmittance about 0.54), and the aerial horizon is a flat grey band with no scarp silhouette (suburb ring and taller scarp were added after the shots).
gaps.ui: The HUD is clean and legible. On phone, the always-on full health/stamina bars sit on the horizon line over the far shore (x 18-200, y 125-155 px). The location banner was large (made smaller after the shots).
gaps.mobile: The phone frame inherits the low horizon (0.38) and the trunk clutter. Low tier is 2.33M tris / 483 calls (perf trims after). The touch cluster stays clear of the player.
gaps.artefacts: Second round below 5. Plane trees are planted inside the other carriageway of St Georges Tce: two 10.9 m one-way ways whose centrelines are 10.9 m apart, with an offset of w/2+2.4 = 7.85 m, which lands 3 m from the other centreline (street_sgt). shops shows a tree on asphalt. Road markings are missing. Palms and lamps are clustered at vertex spacing. The floating BHP crown and its reflection sparkle (river_cbd, aerial) and the KP stakes were fixed after the shots. Likely terracing bands on the west plateau in aerial (KP_HEIGHT stored in 0.3 m uint8 steps on 8 m texels).
gaps.real_game: The hero golden frame is now close to screenshot-worthy as a still. Every street-level frame is an empty, unmarked, shadowless tech demo: no cars, no peds, no paint (street_sgt, shops), partly because cam views spawn traffic and peds around the distant player.

fixes.problem: No lane, centre or edge lines in any shot (street_sgt, shops, aerial). markRoadMaterial() replaces '#include <map_fragment>' with include + paint, but the material's earlier 'pbr' patch (library.js patchPbr) already appended PBR_TINT after that include. Shader order is therefore include, paint, PBR_TINT, and PBR_TINT sets diffuseColor.rgb = sampledDiffuseColor*..., which erases the paint. Only the roughness tweak survives.
fixes.fix: In roads.js markRoadMaterial, anchor the paint block on '#include <color_fragment>' (runs after map_fragment and PBR_TINT) instead of '#include <map_fragment>'. Keep the roughness line on roughnessmap_fragment. Verify with patchKeys(mats.road) and a close shot. Zero cost.

fixes.problem: St Georges Tce is two one-way OSM ways (w 10.9, centrelines 10.9 m apart). lineTrees() plants both sides at w/2+2.4 = 7.85 m, so the inner row lands about 3 m from the other carriageway's centreline: a row of planes down the middle of the road (street_sgt). Barrack St (5.5/10.9/7.8 m one-way ways) puts a trunk on asphalt (shops). keep() only rejects building footprints.
fixes.fix: props.js: filter planePts with !nearRoad(x,z), which uses w/2+1.5 against all ROADS, before keep(). Raise the kerb offset w/2+2.4 to w/2+3.0. For r.oneway, plant only the side whose offset point is not within 2 m of another road. Fewer instances, so a small perf win.

fixes.problem: map.js alongShore() restarts d=0 on every shoreline segment. On the dense OSM shore, palms and lamps land at vertex spacing instead of 18/17 m. Measured near the hero spawn: palms at (105.5,-168.5) and (112.9,-167.7), 7.4 m apart and 1.0 m from the player [112,-168]; lamps at 105.5 and 114.9, 9.4 m apart. Result: 2 trunks + 1 pole flank the player in hero, hero_noon, hero_night and phone_hud, and the palm shadow puts the player in shade.
fixes.fix: Carry the remainder across segments: let carry = phase; for (d = carry; d < L; d += step) {...}; carry = d - L. Give palms phase = step/2 (9 m) so they alternate with lamps (phase 0). Re-check night lamp coverage after (true 17 m spacing) together with the lamp light-map fix. Cuts promenade palm/lamp instances by about 40%.

fixes.problem: Third round below 5 (4, 4.5, 4.5). The towers read as near-white uniform grids, identical from podium to roof (bridge_skyline, river_cbd, aerial). FR.white [0.42..] and lightAlu [0.50..] frames in low sun go near paper-white, and nothing breaks the floor rhythm: real Perth towers show dark plant floors every 15-25 levels and darker glass masses (eq2, kpview).
fixes.fix: towers.js FR: white [0.42,0.43,0.44] to [0.30,0.31,0.32], lightAlu [0.50,0.52,0.53] to [0.38,0.40,0.41], sandstone [0.60,0.48,0.34] to [0.50,0.40,0.29], Convention Centre frame 0.48 to 0.36. facade.js: add a mechanical band, floorIdx = floor(worldY/fh), mech = step(mod(floorIdx + seed*7, 18.0), 0.0) for towers over 80 m. Inside it glass to 0 and frame to vec3(0.07) louvre, with fract(x*6) slats faded by 'far'. Add per-tower glass value jitter glass *= 0.85 + 0.3*fcH(seed). Zero geometry cost.

fixes.problem: tools/qa/shoot.mjs sets P.camPitch = v.pitch ?? 0.16, while player.js now defaults to 0.10, so the r2 composition fix never reached the shots. Measured horizon: hero 0.39, phone_hud 0.38 (target 0.45). Pavers fill the bottom 45% of the frame.
fixes.fix: shoot.mjs: default the pitch to the game value (v.pitch ?? 0.10), or read P.camPitchDefault. Expected horizon about 0.43, with the player still about 30% of frame height.

fixes.problem: game/index.js sets G.focus = player and G.shadowRadius = 120 every frame, and traffic and peds update around the player. In cam views (street_sgt, shops, bridge_skyline, kings_park) the player is 300-1200 m away, so the camera area gets no shadow cascade (no tree or building shadows: street_sgt lower-frame std 0.033), no cars and no people. These views under-represent the game and read as an empty demo.
fixes.fix: When G.camLocked, set tmpFocus to camera.position + forward*45 m (y=0), pass that focus to traffic.update/peds.update, and call traffic.prime(focus) once on lock. shoot.mjs: wait 8 s, then 10 s after the lock so cars populate. In game, this also helps the title flythrough.

fixes.area: night ground lighting: lamp light-map instead of additive pools
fixes.problem: hero_night: player luma 37.6 (floor 40; r1 54.5), luma p5 0.6, right half black. The 'lamp-pools' quads add a flat 0.32*(1,.74,.46) that does not scale with albedo, so the pool is a cream decal with no paver texture and the gap between pools is black.
fixes.fix: props.js: at build time splat every lampM position into a 1024x1024 R8 DataTexture covering x[-700,900] z[-1100,400] (about 1.5 m/texel), Gaussian sigma 5.5 m, max-blended. Patch eq_pavers, road, kerb, lawn and timberDeck: reflectedLight.indirectDiffuse += diffuseColor.rgb * lampC * texture2D(uLampMap, uvXZ).r * uNight * 2.6, plus a 0.04 floor term. Drop the lamp-pools InstancedMesh (-1 call). Texture 1 MB, one fetch.

fixes.problem: Into the sun the frond cards glow saturated yellow (hero right edge, hero_back crown above the bench, the distant EQ row). They read as ribbons, not the dense grey-green Washingtonia fan. The cause is translucency 0.28 times an un-tinted (white) material on a yellowish leaflet colour.
fixes.fix: props.js: foliagePatch(fm, {trans: 0.28}) to 0.16. Set fm.color 0xffffff to 0xb4bca0. In frondTexture, leaflet rgb(84,98,52) to rgb(72,90,56) and dry share 0.08 to 0.12. Frond card W 1.9 to 2.2 m so the fan closes up.

fixes.area: night windows: lit floors not confetti
fixes.problem: Lit rooms are chosen per cell (fcH(cell*0.73+seed)), so towers at night are a uniform salt-and-pepper checkerboard (hero_night right). Real towers light whole floor zones.
fixes.fix: facade.js: lit = step(0.94-0.30*uNight, 0.65*fcH(vec2(floor(cell.x/6.0), cell.y)*0.73+seed) + 0.35*fcH(cell*0.73+seed)), which groups lit runs into 6-bay floor zones. Room night gain stays. Zero cost.

fixes.area: EQ pavers: macro variation, wet sheen, noon value
fixes.problem: The plaza is a perfectly regular stretcher bond over 30+ m, with no staining or water. The tiling reads as CG (hero, hero_back lower half). At noon the 0.13 lime tiles plus sky spec read as a near-white checker (hero_noon, avoid list).
fixes.fix: surfaces.js eqPavers: col *= 0.86 + 0.28*vnoise(gXZ*0.05) (large stain blobs). Wet patches: rough -= 0.28*smoothstep(0.70,0.78,vnoise(gXZ*0.09)) near the quay edge (within 6 m). lime 0.13 to 0.12.

fixes.problem: The inlet edge is a 0.55 x 0.06 m flat strip (hero, hero_back). tricia1 shows EQ's signature ~0.4 m rounded limestone seat-edge, which gives the quay its silhouette and catches rim light.
fixes.fix: ground.js: EQ quay copingGeo(r, 0.55, 0.06) to (0.62, 0.42) with a 0.08 m bevel, island coping to (0.6, 0.42). Leave the South Perth coping. Add a matching collider strip that the player can hop over (jump height permitting).

fixes.problem: The foreground mound in kings_park is near-black lichen noise: shrub albedo 0.045-0.08 x (0.7+0.6*fine) x AO 0.6, which the rubric names as an artefact.

Distance goes milky: the Mends skyline at 1.3 km has blue transmittance of about e^-0.62 = 0.54 (sigma_b 0.00048). The CBD in mends and aerial loses its form. GTA's humid haze keeps silhouettes crisp and tints them instead.
fixes.fix: art.js fog.sigma [0.00020,0.00029,0.00048] to [0.00016,0.00023,0.00036]. Keep scatter, sunInscatter 1.1 and start 45.

fixes.problem: Night player luma 37.6, below the bible floor of 40 (hero_night). The rim was cut correctly, but the body fill is now too low.
fixes.fix: daycycle.js: uCharFill 0.10*uNight to 0.15*uNight. Once the lamp light-map lands, also sample it in avatars.js for a warm under-lamp fill (same uLampMap, gain 0.6).

fixes.problem: The west plateau in aerial shows horizontal banding, consistent with the 0.3 m uint8 height steps on 8 m texels being shaded as terraces. Gentle slopes get stepped normals.
fixes.fix: map.js: when decoding KPD, convert to Float32 and apply one 5x5 Gaussian (sigma 1.2 texels) pass before bilinear sampling. Build-time only.

fixes.problem: phone_hud low tier is 2.33M tris / 483 calls in the shots (perf trims landed after). Bushland shrubs and South Perth garden trees are invisible at the phone hero but still submit.
fixes.fix: props.js on tier 'low': skip the KP shrub scatter entirely, South Perth tree fade [900,1300] to [550,800], KP clump disk r 9.5 to 11.5. The alongShore fix also removes about 40% of promenade palms. Target 1.6M tris / 380 calls at phone_hud; re-measure.

fixes.area: bench legs + Mends deck board scale
fixes.problem: Bench end-blocks render as glaring white blocks, the brightest value near the player (hero, hero_back, phone_hud). Mends jetty boards read about 0.5 m wide (mends).
fixes.fix: props.js benchGeo: legs 'steel' to a dark powder-coat (MeshStandard 0x2e3034, rough 0.5) or 'granite'. index.js timberDeck: makeMaterial('weathered_wood', {tint: 0xb09a80, scale: 1.2}) so boards come out about 0.15 m. Check that Kit box UVs are metric.

fixes.problem: On touch, full health/stamina bars stay visible at top 124 px over the horizon and far shore (phone_hud x 18-200, y 125-155).
fixes.fix: hud.js: add .bars.calm when health >= 100 and stamina >= 0.99 for 3 s; show again on any change. ui.css body.touch .bars top calc(124px+inset) to calc(118px+inset), scale .85 to .78.

Night readability: player luma 54.5 to 37.6 (below the 40 floor), luma p5 5.9 to 0.6, right half of the plaza black. The additive lamp pool wipes the paver texture.
Kings Park view: pale cone stems poking through crowns and a near-black speckled foreground mound (stems and view fixed after the shots; the floor speckle is not).
Floating BHP/Brookfield crown and sign over the skyline, plus its reflection sparkle on Perth Water (fixed after the shots).
hero_back saturation 0.348 to 0.255, and the sky near the sun went beige-white (upper left).
No progress in shops: frame near-identical to r1 (empty unmarked road, flat shopfronts, tree on asphalt).
